scope: VL4 four-bit causal prefix18 independent CPU prescribed-rounding graph with production-options Metal elementary evaluations; finalvocabularyrow17 only

ideal_FP64_difference.claim: This rounding reproduction does not turn ideal FP64 disagreement into an ideal-FP64 pass.

elementary_evaluations.inputs: Independently generated CPU graph intermediates from checkpoint and token IDs; native stages are comparison-only.

reference_C.ABI: lfm3_row_replay(float*,uint8*,float*,float*,float*,int rows,int N,int K,int group,int bits); recorded binary hash proves artifact identity, not reproducible compiler provenance

limits: Ordinary attention reference lacks selected integer-exponent range repair; observed equality validates only measured inputs.
Reference fma uses FP64 multiply/add then FP32 and is not universally correctly rounded fmaf.
Masked elementary evaluations may include NaN/-Inf discarded by reference; these are not asserted as native executed sites.
Only this four-bit prefix18 and finalrow17 are covered; no realimage, six/eight-bit, long-context, performance, or full-fidelity gate is claimed.
